cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I crossed out the fare like the taxi driver. The lift costs petrol and an explanation for three weeks of silence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His cross cancelled a fare. Are you cancelling the petrol money?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, adjusting the account. Petrol's still due, and now tell me why money was the only part you heard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay it. Can we talk about the silence on the way instead of here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Petrol, the three weeks, and why you couldn't face saying it at my door. Keep the radio off.
